name: Seed institutions/students/jobs/applications/MOUs/revenue/comm logs
licence_or_terms: Internal sample data; ships under the repository licence
limitations: Synthetic values. Real college names are borrowed (see DS-2).

name: Real institution names used as demo tenants
licence_or_terms: Names are facts; the attached partnerships/MOUs/payouts are invented
limitations: Presenting invented commercial terms against a named college is a reputational/legal risk. Replace with fictional tenants or obtain permission before external demos.
features_depending_on_it: Tenant labels; landing copy; benchmarking leaderboard

name: KMIT placement records 2017-18..2025-26
licence_or_terms: College-published aggregates are public; granular tuples are not traced to a source
limitations: Site publishes aggregate figures (e.g. 148 companies / 712 offers / ~8.75 LPA for 2025-26). Year-by-year company x CTC x selects rows appear modelled, not sourced.
features_depending_on_it: Placement intelligence; landing stats; year-over-year charts; forecasts

name: DSA curriculum (12 topics / 108 problems)
origin_url: (authored in-repo; pattern coverage informed by public interview-practice sources listed in DATA_SOURCES.md)
licence_or_terms: Authored for this product; no third-party content reproduced
limitations: Prompts and rationale are original. Difficulty labels are editorial. Not a substitute for full test coverage of solutions.
features_depending_on_it: DSA tracker; 30% of readiness score; student AI analysis; faculty DSA intelligence

name: Aptitude sections and topic lists
licence_or_terms: Generic factual topic categories; no single proprietary source identified
limitations: Category names are generic; question content is generated.

name: Company/recruiter names in sample data
licence_or_terms: Names used descriptively; must never be presented as customers/partners
features_depending_on_it: Placement records; recruiter network; landing trust grid

name: Marketing testimonials and star ratings
licence_or_terms: Fictional; labelled illustrative in the UI
limitations: No customer quotes exist. Remove or replace once real evidence exists.

name: Blog post stubs (placement playbooks)
licence_or_terms: Fictional article stubs with no destinations
limitations: Still presented as product content; backlog BL-24.

name: Fonts (Cabinet Grotesk / Satoshi / Fraunces / Inter Tight / JetBrains Mono)
licence_or_terms: Fontshare licence; SIL Open Font Licence for Google Fonts
limitations: Loaded from public CDNs at runtime; self-host for commercial use to remove third-party dependency.

name: Certificate QR images
licence_or_terms: Third-party free API terms not reviewed for commercial volume
limitations: Certificate id is sent to a third party; unreachable service falls back to a decorative fake QR.
features_depending_on_it: Bulk certificate PDFs; certificate verification entry point

name: Live job listings
licence_or_terms: Jooble API terms; key must be rotated (BL-09)
limitations: Not exercised in this audit; integration reads the key from env with no fallback.

name: Health scores and readiness values
licence_or_terms: Derived from sample inputs; not a validated predictive model
limitations: Weights are hand-set (DSA 30/Aptitude 20/ATS 15/Interview 15/CGPA 10/Consistency 10). Do not present as a proven prediction.
features_depending_on_it: Health breakdown; high-risk students; forecasts; what-if simulator

name: Benchmark comparisons
licence_or_terms: Computed in-platform; no external census or national dataset
limitations: Hardcoded benchmark table and 'National Placement Census 2026' citation were removed 2026-10-23.
features_depending_on_it: Analytics workbench benchmark panel; partner benchmarking page

name: Issued certificates
licence_or_terms: Contains student name/program; treated as personal data
limitations: Public verification exposes holder, program, department, institution and date by design.

name: Uploaded MOU/resume files
licence_or_terms: Institution-confidential documents; access restricted to college leadership
limitations: In-memory fallback does not persist uploads across restarts.

name: Audit and notification logs
licence_or_terms: Contain actor email, role, IP and event metadata
